title: bouchea garipensis
intro: Bouchea garipensis, commonly known as the Thai borer, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Thai medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bouchea garipensis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
